Bellingcat February Challenges

Exploring Extremist Symbolism

Bellingcat Challenges February

Introduction

This blog post will show I solved the February OSINT Challenges from Bellingcat. I did these challenges over two days.

Iconography of Hate

I recently saw that Bellingcat published a website that goes into different symbols to describe hate. I figured this would be a good start to solve this challenge. Thus, I went tot he Bellingcat Monitoring Glossary, and looked under the Visual Symbols tab. I opened all the symbols and looked which one matched.

Symbols 2, 3, 6 were present in the Monitoring Glossary, thus, 2, 3, 6 is the answer.
